_help.minSeats: Fewest seats (players + bots) a game can start with.
_help.idleWarnAfterMs: Online: a player whose move the game is waiting for (their turn, draft placement or refresh) who does nothing — no tap, no key, no move — for this long (ms) sees a draining bar on their screen: a bot plays for them soon. 0 = no warning.
_help.idleTakeoverAfterMs: …and after this long (ms, counted from their last tap) a bot plays their seat, mid-turn, until they tap anything. Everyone else gets "X is idle — a bot is playing for them", then "X is back". 0 = never. (The host's turn timer running out hands over the same way.) The server reads this file when it starts: restart npm run party:dev after a change.
_help.botTakesOverAfterMs: A player who drops out mid-game gets a bot after this long, in ms (0 = never). They can still come back.
_help.keepEmptyRoomMs: Everyone gone from a room that isn't kept in storage (a finished game, the lobby): how long (ms) it waits for someone to come back before it's cleared. A match being played is kept instead (keepMatchDays).
_help.keepMatchDays: A match being played is kept in the room's storage on the server, so a server restart or a redeploy loses nothing and players can Rejoin later. It ends (and is deleted) after this many days with no move — a player's, a bot's or the turn timer's. (Muzzy 2026-11-01: 7.)
_help.keepUnplayedMatchHours: A match where no person has made a move yet, with nobody connected, ends after this many hours instead (frees its room code — so a script can't hold every code for keepMatchDays). 0 = never, else at least 1.
_help.allowBots: May the host add bot seats in the lobby? (The game's rules must then play for bots.)
_help.maxMessagesPerSecond: Messages one player's connection may send per second; more are dropped unread (flooding). 0 = no limit.
_help.turnTimerChoices: Glyphtender: the turn timers the host can pick, in seconds (0 = off). The first one is the default. (How long the AI takes on a bot seat's turn: content/ai/pace.json.)

_labels.idleWarnAfterMs: Idle: the warning bar shows after (ms)
_labels.idleTakeoverAfterMs: Idle: a bot plays for them after (ms)
_labels.keepMatchDays: A match is kept with no move for (days)
_labels.keepUnplayedMatchHours: An unplayed match is kept for (hours)
